newsitem.title: USA: Elcor sees Q3 eps in range of $0.26-share.
newsitem.headline: Elcor sees Q3 eps in range of $0.26-share.

text.p: Elcor Corp said it expects its third-quarter earnings to be "in the general range of, or possibly lower than," its earnings from the year-earlier period of $0.26 per share because new plant manufacturing and sales may be below the break-even point.

"The plants have more than double the capacity than the largest plants in the industry," said Richard Rosebery, the company's chief financial officer, "so they have very high fixed costs. Once they get beyond those costs, they'll be highly profitable."
Rosebery said that poor weather during the third quarter typically means a slow season for the industry as well.
